detail.longDescription: 🐳 Portainer 3.0 Goes Kubernetes-First, Leaving Docker Secondary ｢ According to Portainer, the gap between Docker and Kubernetes has grown to the point where maintaining the same capabilities across Docker, Podman, Swarm, and Kubernetes in a single codebase is no longer practical ｣ https:// linuxiac.com/portainer-3-0-goe s-kubernetes-first-leaving-docker-secondary/ # portainer # k8s # docker # containers
